stem: An analyst computes the September logo churn rate of Voltmarkt's Business Care subscription (a monthly device-support plan for small offices) as the cancellations during September divided by the businesses active at the end of September. Why is this wrong?

options.text: The denominator must be the businesses active at the start of September
The denominator must be every business that has ever subscribed to it
The numerator must also count the businesses that subscribed in September
Cancellations must be divided by monthly revenue rather than by businesses
